title: 一碗莲藕排骨汤的秋天
subtitle: 节气、慢火与家的味道

article.en: In Hubei province, autumn means one thing: a hot bowl of soup made from pork ribs and lotus root. It belongs to the 18th solar term, Frost's Descent, when mature lotus roots are rich in starch. In Caidian district of Wuhan, growers read the season by the lotus leaves: when they turn yellow, the roots are ready for harvest. Hubei people eat lotus by season: spring shoots, autumn roots. A rich stock is prepared from pork trotters, pork bones and chicken feet. Salt and sugar season the cut lotus roots, which are rinsed to remove the raw taste. The pork ribs are stir-fried before joining the stock. The mixture then simmers in a traditional pot called a diaozi for about three hours. The result is a milky white broth with a thin film of oil. The roots keep their shape but turn soft, and their sweetness balances the pork. Scallions and black pepper finish the dish. To a family in Hubei this soup means more than dinner: it shows up at wedding banquets and family reunions, and it sits on the Spring Festival table, carrying a blessing for marriage. Xiong Yifu, a chef of thirty years, serves it at food events in Japan, Brazil and France.
article.zh: 在湖北，秋天意味着一件事：一碗用排骨和莲藕炖出的热汤。它属于第18个节气——霜降，此时成熟的莲藕富含淀粉。在武汉蔡甸区，种植户靠莲叶的颜色读懂季节：叶子一黄，水下的莲藕就可以收割了。 湖北人按季节吃莲藕：春天吃藕尖，秋天吃藕。高汤由猪蹄、猪骨和鸡爪熬出。盐和糖给切好的莲藕调味，再冲洗掉生涩的味道。排骨先爆炒，之后才下高汤。所有食材随后在叫作 diaozi（吊子）的传统瓦罐里用小火慢炖约三个小时。 成品是乳白色的汤，表面浮着薄薄一层油。莲藕保持形状，却变得软糯，自身的甜味正好中和了猪肉的厚重。最后撒上葱花和黑胡椒。对湖北家庭而言，这碗汤不只是饭菜：它出现在婚宴和家庭聚会上，也总在年夜饭的桌上，还承载着对婚姻的祝福。做了三十年菜的主厨熊义甫，如今在日本、巴西和法国的美食活动上把这道汤端给远方食客。

vocab.ex: Frost's Descent is the 18th solar term of the Chinese calendar.
vocab.note: 24节气；常用 the 18th solar term，注意 term 用单数

vocab.ex: Mature lotus roots are rich in starch.
vocab.note: be rich in starch 富含淀粉；淀粉类名词在四级阅读里常出现

vocab.ex: The roots are ready for harvest in late autumn.
vocab.note: 作动词时直接带宾语：harvest lotus roots

vocab.ex: Salt and sugar season the cut lotus roots.
vocab.note: 一词两义：名词「季节」/动词「调味」；by season 按季节

vocab.ex: A rich stock is prepared from pork trotters and bones.
vocab.note: 别和 stocks（股票）混；prepare a stock 熬高汤

vocab.ex: The mixture simmers gently in a traditional pot.
vocab.note: simmer vs boil：小火慢炖是 simmer，对应 boil 是大火煮沸

vocab.ex: The result is a milky white broth.
vocab.note: broth 强调汤本身，soup 更宽泛；milky white broth 乳白高汤

vocab.ex: Scallions and black pepper finish the dish.
vocab.note: = green onion；英式拼写用双 l，勿写 scailion

vocab.ex: The soup appears at wedding banquets and Spring Festival meals.
vocab.note: 四级高频；hold/host a banquet 举办宴会

vocab.ex: The lotus root carries a blessing for marriage.
vocab.note: carry a blessing 寓意/承载祝福，比 bring good luck 更书面

vocab.ex: It is more than food but still a dish.
vocab.note: 一道菜用 a dish；菜肴总称用 dishes

translation.title: 传统饮食文化：莲藕排骨汤为什么受欢迎
translation.brief: 下面五句围绕「传统饮食文化」，按「调查数据—原因—意义—措施—展望」的真题结构展开。先读原句圈出采分点，再对照参考译文找表达。

sentences.cn: 据一项调查，湖北莲藕排骨汤在最受喜爱的家乡菜中排名靠前，超过六成的人会在冬季煮它。
sentences.ref: According to a survey, Hubei's pork rib and lotus root soup ranks among the most popular hometown dishes, and more than sixty percent of the respondents cook it in winter.

hints.struct: According to a survey + 主语 + 谓语 + 宾语

pts.t: According to a survey 是「据一项调查」的固定译法，后面直接跟句子，不要加 "According to a survey, it says that"。
排名靠前 用 rank among the most popular；among 表示「在……之中」，后面不接 in。
超过六成的人 是数字改写点，用 more than sixty percent of the respondents；「受访者」译 respondents 比 people who are interviewed 更地道。
并列的两个动作（ranks 与 cook）用 and 连接，主语保持一致，不必另起一句。

sentences.cn: 它受欢迎有两个原因：莲藕和排骨富含营养，慢炖三小时也让汤味更加浓郁。
sentences.ref: There are two reasons for its popularity: lotus roots and pork ribs are rich in nutrients, and slow cooking for three hours makes the broth richer in flavor.

hints.struct: There are two reasons for + 分号并列两个从句

pts.t: 有两个原因 用 There are two reasons for its popularity；for 后接名词，不要写成 reasons of。
富含营养 用 are rich in nutrients；「营养」在此指 nutrient（可数），不要写成 rich in nutrition（前者更准）。
慢炖三小时 用 slow cooking for three hours；for + 时间段 表示持续多久。
更加浓郁 用 richer in flavor（比较级），别漏掉 -er；「汤味」译 the broth 或 the flavor of the soup。

sentences.cn: 它不只是家常菜，也是婚宴上的常客，被视为湖北饮食文化的象征。
sentences.ref: It is not only a home dish but also a common sight at wedding banquets, and it is regarded as a symbol of Hubei's food culture.

hints.struct: not only A but also B + and + 被动句

pts.t: 不只是…而且 固定译法 not only ... but also ...；两个被比较的对象是 a home dish 与 a common sight。
被视为……的象征 用 is regarded as a symbol of；regard A as B 中 as 不能省，也别用 is considered as。
「被视为」是被动语态，主语是 it；翻译时若写成 people regard it as 也可，但要注意和前半句主语衔接。

sentences.cn: 为让年轻人了解这项传统，餐馆应多办美食节，并鼓励厨师学习这道菜。
sentences.ref: To help more young people understand this tradition, restaurants should hold more food festivals and encourage cooks to learn this dish.

hints.struct: To do (目的状语) + 主语 + should do + and do

pts.t: 为让…… 用目的状语 To help ... understand ...；help sb (to) do sth 中 to 可省略。
应多办 是「措施」采分点，用 should hold more ...；情态动词 should 后必须接动词原形。
鼓励厨师学习 用 encourage cooks to learn；encourage sb to do sth 不能写成 encourage sb learning。
两个并列动作（hold 与 encourage）共用一个主语 restaurants，译成 and 连接即可。

sentences.cn: 随着数字菜谱普及，这道汤品有望走向世界，让海外食客尝到家乡的味道。
sentences.ref: With the popularity of digital recipes, this soup is expected to travel overseas and let overseas diners taste the flavor of home.

hints.struct: With + 名词短语, 主句 + and + 动词原形

pts.t: 随着……普及 用 With the popularity of ...；popularity 是名词，不能写成 With the popular of。
有望走向世界 用 is expected to travel overseas；「有望」是 be expected to，别写成 will be hoped to。
让……尝到…… 用 let sb do sth；let 后接省略 to 的不定式：let overseas diners taste ...。
家乡的味道 译 the flavor of home，比 the taste of hometown 更简洁自然。

exprs.note: 引出数据；句首用，后接完整句子。

exprs.en: more than sixty percent of the respondents
exprs.note: 受访者用 respondents；也可用 over 60 percent。
reasons for sth；for 不能换成 of。
be rich in + 复数名词最常见。
for + 时间段；simmer 也能得分。

exprs.en: makes the broth richer in flavor

exprs.note: 两个成分要对等，中间可插入词。

exprs.en: is regarded as a symbol of
exprs.note: regard A as B；as 不能省。
措施题高频；festival 用复数。
let sb do sth；flavor 尤指味道特色。

translation.classroomNote: 课堂速练用的两句（2 句模式默认出这两句；5 句全练出全部）
